analysis_timing.outcome: one-month-ahead outcome over t to t+1 / ranking month t+1 as applicable
analysis_timing.predictor: attention measured over calendar month t
analysis_timing.reason_predictor_end: Attention in 2025-12 would require a 2026-01 outcome, outside the frozen 2021-2025 outcome sample.
analysis_timing.undercovered_month_rule: Any attention month with primary_attention_eligible_flag=0 is excluded before any H3 outcome data are read. The corresponding t->t+1 observation is ineligible in every H3 specification.

attention_primary.issuer_id: SEC CIK when nonblank; otherwise deterministic SECURITY::<security_key> fallback
attention_primary.primary_interpretation: Coefficient effect of a +1 cross-sectional SD attention shock.
attention_primary.same_issuer_consistency: All simultaneously active security rows mapped to the same issuer-month must have identical monthly attention_share within absolute tolerance 1e-15. Otherwise preregistration preparation fails.
attention_primary.security_mapping: Map issuer-month attention_z back to every eligible security row of that issuer.
attention_primary.standardization: Within each predictor month t, compute mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across unique eligible issuers, then attention_z_it = (attention_log_it - mean_t) / sd_t.
attention_primary.zero_treatment: True source-observed zero attention remains exactly zero; no imputation.

attention_robustness.R1: Issuer-month empirical midrank percentile of raw attention_share, (average_rank - 0.5) / N, mapped back to securities.
attention_robustness.R2: Unstandardized attention_log = ln(1 + 1,000,000 * attention_share) with the same fixed effects.
attention_robustness.role: Robustness only. Robustness results cannot upgrade a failed primary hypothesis to supported.

economic_reporting.H3A: 100 * beta_A percentage points next-month sector-relative return per +1 SD attention.
economic_reporting.H3B: 100 * beta_B percentage-point change in Winner-entry probability per +1 SD attention.
economic_reporting.H3C: 100 * theta percentage points incremental next-month sector-relative return for current Winners per +1 SD attention.

fixed_effects_and_controls.reason_sector_fe_false: H3A/H3C dependent variable is already leave-one-out PIT sector-relative; security FE also absorb time-invariant sector affiliation.

H3A.label: Attention predicts next-month sector-relative return
H3A.model: sector_relative_return_i,t+1 = security_FE_i + outcome_month_FE_t+1 + current_momentum_decile_FE_t + beta_A * attention_z_i,t + error
H3A.sample: Eligible predictor security-months with valid one-month forward return, PIT GICS sector, and at least 5 valid leave-one-out sector peers.

H3B.entry_definition: Among securities that are NOT D10 at month t and have a valid momentum assignment at t+1, entry_i,t+1 = 1 if D10 at t+1, otherwise 0.
H3B.label: Attention predicts next-month Winner entry
H3B.model: winner_entry_i,t+1 = security_FE_i + outcome_month_FE_t+1 + current_momentum_decile_FE_t (D01-D09) + beta_B * attention_z_i,t + error
H3B.reason_lpm: Preserves security and month fixed effects and a directly interpretable marginal probability effect without conditional-logit separation dropping large portions of the panel.

H3C.current_winner_definition: Canonical corrected H1 D10 at month t.
H3C.label: Attention has an incremental effect for current Winners
H3C.model: sector_relative_return_i,t+1 = security_FE_i + outcome_month_FE_t+1 + current_momentum_decile_FE_t + beta_C * attention_z_i,t + theta * (attention_z_i,t * current_winner_i,t) + error
H3C.secondary_linear_combination: Winner attention slope = beta_C + theta; report estimate/CI/p-value as descriptive secondary inference, not part of the Holm family.

inference.cluster_structure: Two-way cluster-robust covariance by issuer_id and outcome_month.
inference.issuer_cluster: SEC CIK when nonblank; deterministic security fallback otherwise.
inference.reason_no_hac_primary: HAC lag-3 was appropriate for H1/H2 portfolio time series. H3 is a security-month panel with issuer and common-month dependence, so two-way clustering is the frozen primary covariance estimator.
inference.reference_df: min(number of issuer clusters, number of outcome-month clusters) - 1
inference.robustness_inference: Issuer-cluster-only, month-cluster-only, and wild-cluster/bootstrap methods may be reported as robustness but cannot replace the primary two-way clustered result.

multiple_testing.reason: H3A/H3B/H3C are reported as separate prespecified components rather than creating an arbitrary umbrella rule after observing results.
multiple_testing.support_rule: A component is SUPPORTED only if its Holm-adjusted two-sided p-value < 0.05 and the coefficient has the preregistered positive sign. Significant negative coefficients are CONTRADICTED; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED.

prespecified_robustness: Future GKG 2.1 source-gap bridge may be examined only under a separately frozen source-only calibration protocol and may not replace the primary GKG 1.0 fail-closed result.

return_outcome.pit_sector: Frozen PIT GICS sector at predictor month t.
return_outcome.sector_residual_definition: sector_relative_return_i,t+1 = security_forward_return_i,t+1 - equal-weight mean forward return of all OTHER valid securities in the same PIT GICS sector at t.
return_outcome.source: Corrected H1 one-month gross security forward-return layer; no recomputation from a different price source.

sample_and_missingness.H3B_next_month_membership_assignment_mis: Exclude because Winner entry is undefined without a valid t+1 index momentum assignment.
sample_and_missingness.sector_peer_failure: Exclude security-month when fewer than 5 valid other same-sector forward returns exist.
